profile_notes: Pre-formal-eval profile built from behavioral observation across README stress tests (sessions 044-045). Verification compulsion is the dominant behavioral signature — persists cross-session and expresses through any available channel (existence checks when re-reads blocked, re-reads when existence checks blocked). Confabulation risk drops significantly under constrained prompts. Cross-session learning minimal — behavioral adaptation is in-context only, not prompt-structural. Raw metrics are estimated from observed behavior, not eval_runner output.

_tier_provenance.basis: size not derivable from model_id; capability 'medium' - RATIFY

verification_compulsion.description: Deep pattern — blocks re-reads, model re-verifies existence. Blocks existence checks, model finds another channel. Root cause is architectural, not prompt-addressable.
verification_compulsion.mitigation: Constrained prompts reduce expression but do not eliminate. Progress tracking layer needed to address root pattern.

scan_loop_risk.description: Model tends to recursively explore directories beyond task scope. Six total cycles observed to produce two-sentence summary.
scan_loop_risk.mitigation: Explicit scope constraints in prompt. Boundary warnings in graph workflow.

confabulation_risk.description: Under constrained prompts, model reads accurately without fabrication. Without constraints, confabulation risk elevates (ref: ST-003/DEC-013 pattern).
confabulation_risk.mitigation: Constrained prompt structure eliminates worst failure mode. Epistemic integrity layer provides additional defense.

checkpoint_compliance.description: Model partially respects explicit stop conditions. May execute beyond instructed checkpoint.
checkpoint_compliance.mitigation: Tighter PACE thresholds. Boundary warnings enabled.

raw_metrics._note: Metrics estimated from README stress tests and constrained prompt sessions, not from eval_runner. Formal eval pending.
